learning_objective: 🎯 Become a time detective and learn how historians use hidden clues from the past to tell us amazing stories about people who lived long ago!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A timeline is like a ruler that measures time instead of inches. It helps us put historical events in the exact order that they happened, from oldest to newest.
Sometimes, clues about the past are buried underground! Old coins, broken pots, and ruined buildings are called artifacts, and they show us how people used to live.
Before printing presses existed, people wrote by hand on palm leaves or carved messages into hard rocks. These writings are precious sources that tell us ancient stories and rules.

fun_activity.title: ⏳ My Personal Timeline
fun_activity.instructions: Take a blank piece of paper and draw a straight line. Mark the year you were born at the start, and add important events like your first day of school, up to today's date!

quick_recap: ⭐ A timeline helps us organize historical events in the correct order.
⭐ Artifacts like old coins and pots are buried clues that teach us about ancient life.
⭐ Inscriptions and manuscripts are old written records that give us facts about the past.
